name: suspension in pulley machine in supination stretch
description: Hanging lightly from a pulley handle with palms up stretches the biceps and forearm. The pulley lets you control how much weight you load.
instructions: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
